What you’ll need & color notes

Bring your own Aida fabric, floss, needle and hoop. Check the eyes, nose and fur in the chart before stitching. Thread colors are approximate screen matches: verify them with a physical shade card. Pattern Keeper compatibility and actual test stitching are not certified.
